messages:
sam: Kicking off a staged TF apply for networking/staging -> canary traffic shift in acct-networking. Change window open until 04:30 UTC. Serial applies across AZs, 5m wait between AZ swaps. Ping if you see issues.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] queued: tf:plan for //modules/tgw @ 1742109902

tori: @sam can you paste the exact plan/commands you'll run? want to verify which route tables and attachments change.

sam: Plan/command I'm running:
```
TF_VAR_env=staging terraform plan -target=module.tgw -out=canary-plan.tfplan
terraform apply -auto-approve canary-plan.tfplan
```
Only updating TGW attachments and one route-table swap for the canary subnets. No SG or ACL changes.

ara: Preflight checklist: 1) smoke tests green \u2705 2) canary traffic target = 10% \u2705 3) rollback playbook ready \u2705 4) provider pinned? we had drift last month.

sam: Good catch. Pinning terraform provider aws to 4.29.0 in the workspace for this run. Also using `-lock-timeout=300s` on apply to avoid parallel lock contention.

julie: Oncall watching latency & errors. Thresholds: p95 increase > 10% or error rate > 0.5% absolute => immediate rollback. I'll post a short update every 2m while swapping.

sam: Rollback procedure (ready): 1) apply rollback plan to revert route attachments, 2) unpin or revert provider version in workspace if we detect provider-related drift, 3) open incident channel and escalate. Rollback commands ready:
```
terraform plan -out=rollback.tfplan -target=module.tgw_attachment.canary
terraform apply -auto-approve rollback.tfplan
```

deploy-bot: [deploybot] started: tf:apply canary-plan.tfplan @ 1742110200

tori: Noted. Also disable autoscaler for the canary deployment for 10m so scaling noise doesn't mask issues.

sam: Done — set HPA min=max for canary for 10m.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] apply output: 2 resources changed, 0 added, 0 destroyed. route-table swap applied to canary subnets.

julie: Observing metrics: first 60s p95 +3%, error-rate unchanged. continuing.

penelope: Firewall logs show one expected dropped flow during the swap, otherwise clean.

sam: Proceeding with second AZ swap in 5m. Keeping wait window at 5m between AZs.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] started: tf:apply canary-plan-az2.tfplan @ 1742110804

deploy-bot: [deploybot] apply output: 2 resources changed, 0 added, 0 destroyed. route-table swap applied to AZ-2.

julie: After AZ-2 swap: p95 +9%, error-rate +0.2%. within thresholds. continue to soak at 10% for 15m.

sam: Posting a short release note in the release doc: "tgw: staged canary route swap; provider pinned to 4.29.0; rollback thresholds set; autoscaler frozen for 10m." Will update final status when done.

penelope: :thumbsup:

julie: 15m soak complete, metrics stable. recommending expand to 50% traffic for the next window.

tori: Suggest we keep provider pin through tomorrow's maintenance window to avoid surprise provider upgrades.

sam: Agreed. I'll keep the workspace pin and create a follow-on plan for the 50% shift next window. Closing this change window early; canary stable. Thanks everyone.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] completed run: all applies finished @ 1742111700

ara: Filing a quick note: no rollback needed, provider pin prevented drift. I'll add an automated preflight check to warn if workspace provider != repo pin before future applies.

sam: Nice work, ops. :rocket:
